notes: Voices behind walls sound muffled, like hearing someone through a door - more walls, more muffled.
The talking icon is smaller and sits right of the player's name.
Voice chat actually works now - before, you could join voice but nobody ever heard anyone.
Voice chat now travels through the game's own connection on servers that have the new voice relay, so it works on school Wi-Fi and other networks that used to block it.
New voice chat screen, like Simple Voice Chat: press V. Turn voice on, pick Nearby or Global, mute your mic, turn voice chat off, hide the icons, or mute a player.

Hold Caps Lock to talk, or pick Voice activation in the voice settings to just talk (Chromebooks and Macs start on that). Settings also has a mic test and a level bar for setting how loud you need to be.
A speaker shows over the head of whoever is talking, and your mic state shows in the bottom left corner.
Voice keys: V menu, Caps Lock talk, M mute, N voice off, H hide icons - change them in Controls under Voice Chat.
Voice chat stays on for the next server once you turn it on. If your browser blocks the microphone you can still listen.
